rows.name: size
rows.description: The size of the tab element. Can be "small" or "large". The default value is small

rows.name: variant
rows.description: The variant of the tab element. Can be "hug" or "fill". The default value is fill

rows.name: selected
rows.description: Indicates whether the tab element is selected. The default value is false.

rows.name: text
rows.description: The label text of the tab element.

rows.name: index
rows.description: The index of the tab element.

rows.name: icon
rows.description: The icon name to be displayed in the tab element.

rows.name: badge
rows.description: The badge to be displayed in the tab element.
